observations: Blue industrial-style sewing machine on a white workbench.
Brand 'AIG BROTHER' is printed in blue on the head and a sticker on the base.
The machine has a heavy-duty metal frame and a large motor housing.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or retail environment.
The needle is threaded, and the machine is powered on, with the needle bar moving.
The photo contains a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NANCY ANAEBE'.
The photo is a screenshot of a mobile phone screen.

claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may be non-functional or have a seized mechanism.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The model may be an older, lower-specification industrial model rather than a high-end embroidery machine.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number plate, usually found on the back or underside.

risks.risk: The machine may be a counterfeit or a generic copy of the AIG BROTHER brand.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the model and serial number.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number plate (usually on the back or underside of the machine).
Video of the machine sewing a sample of fabric to prove it works.
Photo of the serial number plate to verify authenticity and age.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
